description: A new Salesforce connection with OAuth2 client credentials: each literal becomes a required configurable named after the connection and the init field, with its value in Config.toml, including an optional credential (proxy password) and a required one under an optional record (key store password); a code point escape becomes the character itself in Config.toml, escaped as TOML needs

config.value: {baseUrl: "https://acme.my.salesforce.com", auth: {tokenUrl: "https://acme.my.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", clientId: "sales-client", clientSecret: "s3cr\"et"}, apiVersion: "60.0", timeout: 30, proxy: {host: "proxy.acme.com", password: "pr0xy\u{1F600}\u{22}\\u{41}"}, secureSocket: {key: {path: "/certs/sales.p12", password: "ks-pass"}}}

new_connection-salesforce/connections.ba.newText: final salesforce:Client sfSales = check new ({baseUrl: sfSalesBaseUrl, auth: {tokenUrl: sfSalesAuthTokenUrl, clientId: sfSalesAuthClientId, clientSecret: sfSalesAuthClientSecret}, apiVersion: sfSalesApiVersion, timeout: sfSalesTimeout, proxy: {host: sfSalesProxyHost, password: sfSalesProxyPassword}, secureSocket: {key: {path: sfSalesSecureSocketKeyPath, password: sfSalesSecureSocketKeyPassword}}});
